previousRule: The source tests covered historical insert stock observations and approved HCI component hashes but did not assert a public Design Library destination or a currently orderable 55 cm filled cushion.
newRule: The source tests retain approved HCI hashes, require all six Design Library topics to render on the CurtainsUK storefront with useful shopping links and context preservation, and require the supplier-observed 55 cm filled cushion to price and remain orderable while unavailable inserts still fail closed.
reason: The cross-tool audit found six broken guide links, fabric URLs built on the wrong host, unavailable visualiser defaults and a 55 cm cushion stock observation that has since changed. The new tests protect the customer journey without weakening pricing, stock or checkout authorities.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested a focused storefront reliability release. This protected regression-test and policy-record change still requires Nylon1's exact-current-head PR comment before merge or deployment; this record does not grant approval.
